probe: runtime enum-membership attack on trust boundary

attack1.input: createCanonicalClinicalFact({type:'procedure', speaker:'clinician', evidenceType:'clinician_observed', value:{name:'X'}, status:'PERFORMED', temporal:'future', evidence:[]})
attack1.expected: rejected (performed+future is in the status×temporal conflict matrix)
attack1.why: checkStatusTemporalCompatibility compares against exact lowercase enum literals; the wrong-case string 'PERFORMED' fails every === guard and is accepted verbatim into the canonical fact with validationState 'valid'

attack2.input: createCanonicalClinicalFact({type:'symptom', speaker:'robot', evidenceType:'made_up', value:'pain', status:'observed', temporal:'current', evidence:[]})
attack2.why: validateClinicalFactInvariants checks only two speaker/evidenceType combinations ('patient'+'clinician_observed'); any unknown speaker string passes both guards unchecked

attack3.input: createCanonicalClinicalFact({... teeth:[36], surfaces:['O'] ...}) (teeth/surfaces at candidate top level, not under anatomy)
attack3.expected: rejected or at minimum not silently dropped
attack3.why: CandidateClinicalFact.anatomy is the only read location; stray top-level teeth/surfaces are silently discarded (no error) — extraction code passing the wrong shape loses anatomy silently

significance: The trust boundary trusts that TS types are runtime truth. Candidates arrive from LLM extraction (untrusted JSON per CLINICAL_FACT_SPECIFICATION.md). No enum-membership whitelist exists at createCanonicalClinicalFact entry.
impact: A malformed model output carrying wrong-cased status ('PERFORMED'+'future') is admitted as a canonical fact marked validationState:'valid', verificationState:'unverified' — the planned!=performed matrix is bypassable by casing. Downstream renderer checks (adaptFactsToLegacyFindings compares fact.status === 'performed'/'planned' with ===) would then treat it as neither — the fact silently drops out of performed rendering while carrying 'valid'.
severityAssessment: HIGH candidate, not assessed CRITICAL by this worker: canonical facts default verificationState 'unverified', the sign gate blocks on flagged/rejected facts and fail-closed grounding, and the deterministic extractor (statusOf) emits lowercase literals. Exploit requires a malformed upstream extraction; no live path was found where a client can inject candidates directly (Phase 7 seam: ClinicalFact pipeline not yet wired to the production note path).
